strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Hurst Exponent
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9/26) approximates the Tenkan/Kijun relationship and ADX(14) approximates the Hurst trend-strength filter. Ichimoku cloud, Hurst exponent, opposite signal, and ATR-based stops are not representable as fixed percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Market Trend Levels Non-Repainting
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20/50) and RSI(14) are explicit fallbacks because the source supplies no periods or thresholds; the crossover and optional RSI filter are retained. The 5-minute timeframe and exit-filter toggle are not modeled.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Bands Modified
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Bollinger length/deviation (20/0.38) and enabled EMA(80) filter are retained. Recent-high/low stops, the 1.6 risk target, and the 5-minute timeframe are represented only by the mean-band/EMA exit.

strategy_roster.name: BrakeExp Channel
strategy_roster.notes: The unavailable BrakeExp exponential curve is approximated by an EMA(20)/SMA(20) regime cross, with the inverse cross closing a long. A, B, order permissions, timeframe, and the documented absence of stops are retained or omitted as noted.

strategy_roster.name: Ichimoku Volume Cluster
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,9) > ema(close,26) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and std(volume,20) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9/26) and volume_ratio(20) with a positive 20-bar volume deviation proxy the Ichimoku trend/volume cluster. Ichimoku spans, the 2.0 volume multiplier, and ATR protection are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci-Only Strategy V2
strategy_roster.notes: The 19% retracement is approximated with a 93-bar SMA/range expression and a bullish cross; the 82.56% level and candle confirmation are not encoded. ATR/trailing stops, 15-minute execution, and other Fibonacci levels are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Last ZZ50
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 10-bar high break is a deterministic proxy for a ZigZag swing and pending buy-stop midpoint. ZigZag depth/deviation/backstep, pending-order updates, session filters, and pip trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Executer AC
strategy_roster.notes: MACD sign and one-bar slope provide an executable proxy for the four-bar Accelerator Oscillator acceleration patterns. The AC buffer, fixed pip targets, trailing routine, and zero-line reversal detail are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Random Coin Toss
strategy_roster.notes: The source explicitly randomizes direction at EntryFrequency bars, so an impossible negative-price guard avoids inventing a deterministic coin result. ATR(14) with 1x/2x multipliers is not a fixed percentage field.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Eraser
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)>50 with an EMA(20) gate retains the documented long-side direction. Daily high/low protection, one-entry-per-day state, pip stops/targets, and risk-based sizing are not available in the DSL.
